key_reasoning.reason: Whole in-house A2A layer touched: client (card resolver, client, remote connection), server (task managers), shared types/utils/version module, router, assistant handler, plus the integration guide. Shared wire contracts rewritten across client and server.

Protocol wire-shape rewrite to A2A v1.0 (method names, enums, Part shapes, version negotiation via A2A-Version header, JSON-RPC error codes). Wire-contract tests with 20 JSON fixtures were needed. Verification found a serialization bug on DB-loaded tasks and an HTTP status bug for JSON-RPC errors; one review round produced 8 findings. Mitigated by e2e verification against official a2a-sdk demo agents and Postgres.

42 files changed (about 21 listed source/test/doc files plus 20 JSON fixtures), 4124 insertions and 2296 deletions. The XXL mapping is driven by the file count, but roughly half are test fixtures and tests.
API (router), Service (task managers, handler), Persistence (task serialization from DB), External (remote A2A agents). No UI or infrastructure changes.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk at XL: protocol wire-contract change with version negotiation and cross-system interop
Component Scope at XL: touches shared contracts (types, utils) used by both client and server
